art_direction: 双眼轻微错落，短上弧一轻一重，双瞳向左上，短眉无嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Place one eye a small step higher, keeping their widths close. Draw each upper arc in a short pen pull, with the lower eye receiving slightly more pressure. Both pupils turn gently up and left, leaving broad dark centers and small uneven paper gaps. Under each eye, add a lower stroke that stops before the outer corner. Two brief brows follow the unequal eye heights. No mouth. Keep the expression alert without circles, lashes, or tiny decorative lines.
